source_findings: DNS.updateOne retains the previous IP list when a retry has no valid answers.
The retry interval can increase to two minutes. That interval does not expire the retained address list.
EgressDNS.updateEntryForName reads the retained list and writes it to the address set.
image_metadata_check: The metadata request was denied with an explicit empty registry auth file. No cluster pull Secret was read and no credential was changed.
conclusion: Do not infer bounded old-address removal after DNS failure from provider support or retry intervals. Qualify the exact installed implementation and its traffic behavior.
